text: CodeDeploy is a deployment service that provides safe, automated deployments for applications running on EC2, ECS, and Lambda. It supports one-box, canary, and linear deployment strategies with automatic rollback on alarm.
title: CodeDeploy overview

text: To deploy with CodeDeploy, create a deployment configuration that specifies the compute platform, deployment strategy, and alarm configuration. CodeDeploy will monitor CloudWatch alarms during deployment and trigger an automatic rollback if any alarm enters ALARM state.
title: CodeDeploy configuration

text: CDK constructs for Aurora Serverless v2 clusters support the serverlessV2ScalingConfiguration property which controls minimum and maximum ACU. Setting minCapacity to 0 allows the cluster to scale to zero when idle, reducing costs for development and low-traffic workloads.
title: CDK Aurora Serverless v2

text: Lambda functions have a cold start penalty when the execution environment is initialized. For Java and .NET runtimes, cold starts can exceed 5 seconds. Provisioned concurrency keeps a specified number of environments warm, eliminating cold starts at the cost of continuous billing.
title: Lambda cold start optimization

text: S3 event notifications can trigger Lambda functions, SQS queues, or SNS topics when objects are created, deleted, or restored. Use event filtering with prefix and suffix rules to limit which object keys trigger the notification.
title: S3 event notifications

text: IAM policy conditions support aws:PrincipalOrgID to restrict access to principals within a specific AWS Organization. This is useful for cross-account access patterns where you want to allow any account in the organization without maintaining an explicit account list.
title: IAM cross-org access

text: DynamoDB single-table design uses a composite primary key (PK/SK) to store multiple entity types in one table. Access patterns are modeled as key conditions on PK and SK, with GSIs for alternative access patterns. This reduces the number of tables and simplifies capacity management.
title: DynamoDB single-table design

text: ECS Fargate tasks run without managing EC2 instances. Task definitions specify CPU, memory, container images, and networking configuration. Fargate pricing is per-vCPU-hour and per-GB-hour, billed from task start to task stop.
title: ECS Fargate overview

text: CodePipeline is a CI/CD service that models build, test, and deploy stages as a directed graph. Each stage can contain parallel actions. It supports source actions from CodeCommit, S3, GitHub, and Bitbucket, with built-in integrations for CodeBuild and CloudFormation.
title: CodePipeline CI/CD

text: CloudFormation stack policies prevent accidental updates to critical resources. A stack policy is a JSON document that specifies which resources can be updated during a stack update operation. By default, all resources are protected once a stack policy is applied.
title: CloudFormation stack policies
